title: taraxacum officinale f. commutatum
intro: Taraxacum officinale f. commutatum, commonly known as the common dandelion or French dandelion, is a flowering plant that belongs to the dandelion species. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and support liver function. The therapeutic actions of Taraxacum officinale f. commutatum include its use as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which can help to alleviate symptoms of urinary issues, arthritis, and other oxidative stress-related conditions. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
